description: Install a plugin: pluginSlug from WordPress.org, or lafuProduct (+ optional version) for one of our own released plugins. Confirm required. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

lafuProduct.description: Our own plugin (licence product slug, e.g. lafu-gift-cards). Installs its published release.

pluginSlug.description: WordPress.org plugin slug, for example woocommerce.

serviceId.description: Service id of the website or service (from oma_read_services).

version.description: Release version for lafuProduct. Default: latest stable.

name: oma_wp_install_plugin
title: Install WordPress plugin
